name: GPU Voxelization with Shared Memory Cache and Global Memory Fallback
definition: A CUDA kernel that maps 3D points to a voxel grid using a block-level shared memory cache for aggregation, falling back to atomic operations on global memory for cache collisions.
summary: A CUDA kernel that maps 3D LiDAR points to a voxel grid by aggregating attributes into a block-level shared memory cache, falling back to atomic operations on global memory for cache collisions.
